name: SmartVidDownloader
intro: SmartVidDownloader saves videos and audio from links, then turns them into searchable transcripts you can edit, export and ask AI about. Here is a quick tour of how it works.

features.download-by-link: Paste a link, fetch its details, then choose video or audio and start the download. You can also drop a link onto the page, which saves the file for you.
features.formats-and-quality: After fetching, a dialog lists the available formats with quality, size and frame rate. Advanced options let you set a start and end time, so you only download the part you need.
features.download-playlist: To save a whole playlist or channel, preview its videos first, tick the ones you want or set a range, then download them together as one group in the queue.
features.download-queue: The queue lists every download with its progress, speed and status. You can pause, resume, cancel or retry an item, and open its logs when something fails.
features.transcripts: Click Transcribe on a download, or drop in your own audio or video file. The app prepares the audio, detects speech and identifies speakers, then gives you searchable text.
features.speaker-labels: Transcripts mark who is speaking, and the speaker list shows each person's share of talking time. If voices get mixed up, adjust the number of speakers and update the labels.
features.export: Export a transcript as text, markdown or subtitles, and check the preview first. You can also make a video with captions, either as a switchable subtitle track or burned into the picture.
features.ai-skills: In the transcript sidebar, run a skill to get an overview, bullet points, a FAQ, a mind map, a translation or a rewritten article. Skills use the AI provider you set up.
features.chat-and-agent: Open Chat and describe what you want in plain words, like downloading a video or extracting its audio. The agent does the steps, and asks your permission when it needs it.

outro: That's SmartVidDownloader. Start with one link, add a transcript, and let the AI skills turn a long video into notes you can use.
